prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints produced multiple significant wins, whereas hints on other steps showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Desktop hotkey setup screens, guide screens, and quick-action redesigns on the finish step were helpful and drove strong wins.
Wait-stage info updates on home and adoption steps yielded several wins, though many showed no clear effect.
Layout modifications and copy updates consistently resulted in no clear effect or worse performance, with zero wins.
Most other new screens and flows showed no clear effect or hurt performance, occasionally triggering early test stops.
Predictions underestimated gains for finish-step hotkey and quick-action improvements while overestimating gains for ineffective changes.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Pet Profile Sync Preservation Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores existing pet profiles and syncs pet memory across devices. (why: Support mail shows 8 users reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in hints have consistently driven significant wins.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Interaction Hotkey Cheat-Sheet Screen: Adds a new screen right after home intro displaying an interactive hotkey reference map for pet visibility, summoning, and voice controls. (why: Support tickets highlight user confusion about controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding, while finish-step hotkey screens have proven high impact.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Trait Loading Stage Time Indicator: Displays a clear live processing stage indicator and estimated completion timer while rendering the custom pet visual on the waiting screen. (why: The home step has a median waiting duration of 201s (mean 2336s), and wait-stage info updates on home have yielded multiple clear wins.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Profile Restoration Hint: Displays a reassuring notice above sign-in options confirming that logging in prevents duplicate profiles and links cloud memory. (why: 8 support emails detail lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating, and sign-in hints are proven top performers in past tests.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quick Command Training Flow: Introduces a brief interactive training flow screen at the finish step where users practice summoning, dragging, and muting their desktop pet. (why: Multiple post-onboarding support issues report confusion with pet interaction, and finish step interactive guide flows are proven drivers of retention.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Pet Trait Generation Live Status Step Info: Adds live status updates showing pet trait assembly, texture synthesis, and custom audio preview during adoption photo processing. (why: The adoption step drops to 65.2% conversion with long wait times (median 89s), and support tickets show custom pet generation failures/confusion.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray & Visibility Quick Reference Screen: Adds a dedicated system tray and visibility reference screen at the end of onboarding that explains how to reveal, hide, or pin the pet window. (why: Support mail highlights 3 bug reports where pets do not show on desktop and 3 tickets about hiding/controlling pets.)
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Trait Rendering Fallback Hint: Adds a helpful status hint on the photo upload screen guaranteeing high-quality preset fallback if photo trait generation fails or stalls. (why: Support logs include custom pet generation failures and unusual visual results, contributing to the adoption step's 34.8% drop-off.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Trait Customization Hint: Adds a clear hint on choose_path explaining how chosen path options influence pet interactions and initial desktop behavior. (why: The choose_path funnel drops nearly 21% of users right at the start; providing clear expectations helps guide confident path selection.)
